label: Eluria Voyage
name: Chapter Key: Eluria Voyage
note: Hilton: ENTER_FIELD (ev_2800500) at MF_0015_01A, window starting at 2800500, advances to 2900000. The trace shows the story then running unattended through the "Aboard the Ship" sequence (MF_0023_51A, ev_2900000/2901000/2902000) to Elurian Coast (MF_0025_01A) at 3000000 and on to Eluria Settlement (MF_0026_01A) at 3100000, all seen in order in the same session. This is an ENTER_FIELD trigger, not a CONVERSATION: refusing it means entering Hilton at 2800500 starts nothing and the town stays usable (shops, inn, ferry); re-entering Hilton after the key arrives starts the voyage. If the party is already inside Hilton when the key arrives they must leave and re-enter, since ENTER_FIELD only evaluates on map entry. The locked behaviour itself is expected, not yet observed live (this session's room only mapped keys 1-3).

label: The Four Fields
name: Chapter Key: The Four Fields
note: City Hall: EVENT_COLLISION (ev_4100000) at MF_0030_26A, window starting at 4100000, advances to 4200000. The scenario trace shows progress moving from 4001000 to 4100000 on leaving the Cave of Crimson Crystals onto the NEDE world map, then to 4200000 at City Hall. The events trace shows ev_4100000 evaluated twice before it ran (IsEnable=True on entering the NEDE world map, IsEnable=True again on entering MF_0030_26A) and StartScenario firing about 4.2 s after the second, once the party walked into the collision trigger; afterward it kept polling IsEnable=False every 10-20 s while the party stayed in City Hall, unlike an ENTER_FIELD gate's single post-fire check. This is an EVENT_COLLISION trigger, not a CONVERSATION or ENTER_FIELD: refusing it should leave the collision trigger inert on contact while City Hall stays otherwise usable, and touching the trigger again after the key arrives should start it immediately, with no map re-entry needed since a collision trigger is evaluated on contact. That locked behaviour is expected, not yet observed (this session's room only mapped keys 1-3).
